overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance shows that relationship dynamics, particularly husband-wife emotional realities and family bonds, significantly outperform abstract sad shayari or generic self-motivation videos.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1766 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1674 views) heavily outperformed all other content.
winning_patterns.action: Focus more content on mature relationship struggles, unspoken marital expectations, and domestic emotional realities.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on specific family roles like Mother ('माँ जब पूछती है') and Father ('पापा कभी कहते नहीं') performed decently compared to generic emotional quotes.
winning_patterns.action: Continue utilizing specific family-centric emotional triggers rather than broad statements.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' gained only 14 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid overly dramatic, poetic, or abstract shayari hooks that lack an immediate grounded real-life context.

weak_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'तुम थके हो… हारे नहीं' received low engagement (172 views) compared to topical relationship discussions.
weak_patterns.action: Rely less on generic self-help motivation and more on situational relationship friction.
